_capture.method: fetched with the Arena fetch tool (the development sandbox has no outbound network; CI does)
_capture.completeness: complete response as returned: 2 finalized contracts plus the paging cursor. Both contracts are for the same event (2026 Stanley Cup Final game, Carolina vs Vegas, 2026-06-15).
_capture.why_it_matters: Proves that (a) KXNHLTOTAL totals contracts have a historical tier at all, so a totals BACKTEST is possible rather than forward-only, and (b) the line is carried in the numeric floor_strike / strike_type fields, because the historical tier's title ('Carolina vs Vegas: Total Goals') does not contain the line while the live tier's title ('Full Game: Over 8.5 goals scored') does. The strike is therefore read from the fields, never parsed from the title.
_capture.also_note: rules_secondary states the settlement rule this project implements: regulation and overtime goals count normally and a shootout counts as one goal for the winner -- which is what the NHL's official final score already contains.

markets.rules_primary: If over 9.5 total combined goals are scored in the Carolina vs Vegas professional hockey game originally scheduled for Jun 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Goals scored during regulation and overtime count as normal. If the game is decided by a shootout, the shootout result will be recorded as one goal awarded to the winning team.
